title: ever LILAS|Elegant Short Sleeves A-Line Waist Applique Formal Dress with Lotus Leaf Hem
descriptionHtml:
Embrace timeless elegance in our Elegant Short Sleeves A-Line Waist Applique Formal Dress with Lotus Leaf Hem. The delicate applique detailing enhances the charm of short sleeves and an A-line waist, creating a graceful silhouette. The lotus leaf hem adds a touch of whimsy to this formal dress, making it an exquisite choice for special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
